title: Immunizations and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay \(ELISA) for antibody isotype determination
protocol: Prepare KLH or DNP-KLH in alum precipitate as described.
Inject 100 µg of KLH or DNP-KLH precipitated in alum into the peritoneal cavity in a total volume of 300 μl adjusted with PBS.
Collect serum at days 0, 7, and 14 and make serial dilutions in PBS.
Coat 96-well MaxiSorp™ ELISA plates with 50 µl/well of DNP-ovalbumin (5 µg/ml in PBS).
Wash plates three times with PBS + 0.05% Tween 20, then block for 3 hours with PBS + 2.5% bovine serum albumin.
Wash plates three times with PBS + 0.05% Tween 20.
Add diluted serum in triplicates to the ELISA plates and incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Wash plates three times with PBS + 0.05% Tween 20.
Add alkaline phosphatase-labeled mouse IgM- and subclass IgG-specific antibodies (working dilutions 1:250 – 1:500 in PBS + 2.5% bovine serum albumin) to the ELISA plates.
Wash plates five times with PBS + 0.05% Tween 20.
Add 100 µl per well of alkaline phosphatase substrate solution.
Read optical density of each well at 405 nm at 10 minutes and 20 minutes after substrate addition.
